apiConfigModule.pageSubtitle: Configure and switch between ItemAI API, ItemServerAI API, OpenAI, and OpenRouter APIs
apiConfigModule.descItemai: Local AI powered by LM Studio - 100% free, 100% private, runs on your own computer with downloaded models.
apiConfigModule.descItemserverai: Network AI powered by LM Studio - 100% free, 100% private, runs on your internal network server with downloaded models.
apiConfigModule.descOpenai: Direct access to OpenAI models (GPT-5, GPT-4, etc.) with full control and reliability.
apiConfigModule.descOpenrouter: Access to multiple AI providers through OpenRouter, often more cost-effective with access to Claude, Gemini, and other models.
apiConfigModule.hintItemaiUrl: Local URL where LM Studio is running (default: http://localhost:1234)
apiConfigModule.hintItemserveraiUrl: Network URL where LM Studio is running on your server (default: http://192.168.50.142:1234)
apiConfigModule.step1Body: Choose between ItemAI API (free local), ItemServerAI API (free network), OpenRouter (cost-effective), or OpenAI (premium quality).
apiConfigModule.step2Body: Enter your API keys for the selected provider. Keys are stored locally in your browser.
apiConfigModule.step3Body: Use the "Test API" button to verify your configuration works correctly.
apiConfigModule.step4Itemai: If ItemAI API fails, the system automatically falls back to OpenRouter, then OpenAI for maximum reliability.
apiConfigModule.step4Itemserverai: If ItemServerAI API fails, the system automatically falls back to OpenRouter, then OpenAI for maximum reliability.
apiConfigModule.step4Openrouter: If OpenRouter fails, the system automatically falls back to OpenAI for reliability.
apiConfigModule.step4Openai: OpenAI provides direct access with fallback to mock responses if needed.
apiConfigModule.compareItemai1: Pros: 100% free, 100% private, no rate limits
apiConfigModule.compareItemai2: Cons: Requires local setup, model quality varies
apiConfigModule.compareItemai3: Best for: Privacy, cost savings, local development
apiConfigModule.compareItemserverai1: Pros: 100% free, 100% private, no rate limits, network accessible
apiConfigModule.compareItemserverai2: Cons: Requires network server setup, model quality varies
apiConfigModule.compareItemserverai3: Best for: Privacy, cost savings, network-based development
apiConfigModule.compareOpenrouter1: Pros: Lower costs, multiple providers, Claude/Gemini access
apiConfigModule.compareOpenrouter3: Best for: Cost optimization, model variety
apiConfigModule.compareOpenai1: Pros: Direct access, reliable, latest models
apiConfigModule.compareOpenai2: Cons: Higher costs, potential rate limits
